sections.bearsOn: Continues the Environment and Land Use Committee of cabinet ministers.
The committee's duties: environmental awareness and ensuring environmental preservation is considered in land use and resource development.
The committee may hold inquiries and appoint technical committees.
Inquiry powers of the chair and members.

On the committee's recommendation and despite any other Act, Cabinet may make orders on the environment or land use, and a minister named in an order must exercise other powers, the Forest Act's included, only in accordance with it; ELUA protected areas and some land use restrictions rest on such orders, whose terms are not public in the layer.
sections.gapNote: The protected area screen marks every activity "unknown, the establishing order decides"; no rule asks the reviewer what the order establishing the area under the block allows.
